maria_ops: Quick check-in — following last week's outage (cloud auth flap + model-registry latency spike) I put together a short actions list. Can owners confirm ETA and if they need help?
kevin_eng: Thanks Maria. I'm owner for the model-registry fallback work. Plan is: snapshot-index caching + fast-path read fallback. Targeting small dry-run tomorrow morning.
jason_infra: I'm on the auth provider circuit breaker and token refresh smoothing. Found that refresh jitter correlated with our burst window. Will throttle refreshes and add exponential backoff.
olivia_pm: Can we get a one-line summary of the user impact we should communicate to CS? Pete, any customer escalations to note?
pete_support: A few customers saw 5-15s extra latencies for generation calls; one support ticket (SUP-984) reported 502s during the 6m window. Customers OK with postmortem; they want mitigation dates.
kevin_eng: Dry-run checklist: 1) deploy cached index in canary (10%); 2) simulate registry API 503 for 30s; 3) confirm failed reads route to cached index with no data-corruption. Script: `./tools/drill/run_registry_fallback.sh --canary 10`
maria_ops: Adding owners/tickets so this is tracked: model-registry fallback: kevin_eng -> TICKET: INF-3421; auth backoff: jason_infra -> TICKET: INF-3422; communication + CS notes: olivia_pm + pete_support -> TICKET: COMM-1209.
kevin_eng: ETA: dry-run tomorrow 09:30 UTC, rollout to prod if green by 14:00 UTC. Need infra support for canary routing, @jason_infra can you reserve canary lanes?
jason_infra: Yep reserving 2 GPU nodes for canary, will also enable verbose tracing for KV cache paths. Also adding temporary metric `registry.fallback_rate` and alert at >0.5% per minute.
olivia_pm: I'll draft the customer-facing summary: "We experienced a short outage on X due to upstream auth token churn and model registry latency. We're deploying a cached-index fallback and auth refresh smoothing; target mitigation tomorrow." Will share for review at 08:30 UTC.
pete_support: I'll prep SUP-984 response and flag customers who requested SLAs.
sre-bot: ACTION_CREATED: INF-3421 (kevin_eng) -> due 2026-03-26; INF-3422 (jason_infra) -> due 2026-03-26; COMM-1209 (olivia_pm,pete_support) -> due 2026-03-25
kevin_eng: Quick note — fallback introduces stale index risk for ~30s. We'll add a validation step comparing cached snapshot vs live index hash every 60s. If mismatch >0.5% abort fallback.
maria_ops: Good. Also propose weekly 3rd-party-dep drills on Fridays 09:00 UTC for next 6 weeks to catch recurrence. Owners: infra + eng + SRE on rotation.
jason_infra: Agreed. I'll own rotation schedule for April. Can we make runbook snippets in the playbook? Example snippet to trigger fallback: ```
# runbook: trigger registry fallback
curl -X POST https://internal-api/run/fallback -d '{"canary":10}'
```
kevin_eng: Will add the snippet to infra runbook and add a post-run checklist: monitor latency, fallback_rate, error_budget burn.
olivia_pm: I'll add cadence to the roadmap and loop in account managers for high-risk customers.
pete_support: Flag: confirm whether Dedicated customers need a different comms path. I'll open SUPPORT-1193.
maria_ops: Ok final check: please update ticket INF-3421/3422 status when you start. We'll run the dry-run, then meet 30m after for quick retro. Thanks all. :thumbsup!
file_description: postmortem follow-up thread for cloud auth + model-registry outage; action owners, tickets, dry-run plan, and cadence
